source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    top, bottom, left, right = r0 + 1, r1 - 1, c0 + 1, c1 - 1
    depth = 0
    while bottom - top + 1 > 3 and right - left + 1 > 3:
        color = 2 if depth % 2 == 0 else 5
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            out[top][c] = color
            out[bottom][c] = color
        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            out[r][left] = color
            out[r][right] = color
        top += 1
        bottom -= 1
        left += 1
        right -= 1
        depth += 1
    return out
'''
